import pandas as pd

annual = pd.DataFrame(datasets['311cf5940915e703f908b78f818a77be']).set_index('analysis_year')
repeat = pd.DataFrame(datasets['7bb8e73be4ac4209db12310e6e10ca3b']).set_index('analysis_year')
region = pd.DataFrame(datasets['9cc69708b2c016d6b00e65944c79ac3f'])
category = pd.DataFrame(datasets['84fcf77a32469ffd7137c248d0968bf7'])
quality = pd.DataFrame(datasets['9dc559a49a030eab694f9ea6f5c2a4f0']).set_index('analysis_year')
recon = pd.DataFrame(datasets['234dd362f5ee030cf0bced124e9fd4f4']).set_index('analysis_year')

b_year = int(annual.index.min())
c_year = int(annual.index.max())
b_orders = int(annual.loc[b_year, 'order_count'])
c_orders = int(annual.loc[c_year, 'order_count'])
b_revenue = float(annual.loc[b_year, 'order_revenue_source_units'])
c_revenue = float(annual.loc[c_year, 'order_revenue_source_units'])
b_aov = float(annual.loc[b_year, 'average_order_value_source_units'])
c_aov = float(annual.loc[c_year, 'average_order_value_source_units'])
b_customers = int(repeat.loc[b_year, 'ordering_customer_count'])
c_customers = int(repeat.loc[c_year, 'ordering_customer_count'])
b_repeat = int(repeat.loc[b_year, 'repeat_customer_count'])
c_repeat = int(repeat.loc[c_year, 'repeat_customer_count'])
b_repeat_rate = float(repeat.loc[b_year, 'repeat_customer_rate'])
c_repeat_rate = float(repeat.loc[c_year, 'repeat_customer_rate'])

order_change = c_orders - b_orders
revenue_change = c_revenue - b_revenue
aov_change = c_aov - b_aov
repeat_rate_change_pp = (c_repeat_rate - b_repeat_rate) * 100
repeat_rate_relative = (c_repeat_rate / b_repeat_rate - 1) if b_repeat_rate != 0 else None

region_revenue_b = float(region['revenue_2002_source_units'].sum())
region_revenue_c = float(region['revenue_2003_source_units'].sum())
region_orders_b = int(region['order_count_2002'].sum())
region_orders_c = int(region['order_count_2003'].sum())
category_revenue_b = float(category['revenue_2002_source_units'].sum())
category_revenue_c = float(category['revenue_2003_source_units'].sum())
unclassified = category[category['product_category_name'] == '未分类']
unknown_regions = region[region['region_name'] == '未知区域']

result = pd.DataFrame([{
    'baseline_year': b_year,
    'comparison_year': c_year,
    'order_count_baseline': b_orders,
    'order_count_comparison': c_orders,
    'order_count_change': order_change,
    'order_count_growth_pct': (order_change / b_orders * 100) if b_orders else None,
    'revenue_baseline_source_units': b_revenue,
    'revenue_comparison_source_units': c_revenue,
    'revenue_change_source_units': revenue_change,
    'revenue_growth_pct': (revenue_change / b_revenue * 100) if b_revenue else None,
    'aov_baseline_source_units': b_aov,
    'aov_comparison_source_units': c_aov,
    'aov_change_source_units': aov_change,
    'aov_growth_pct': (aov_change / b_aov * 100) if b_aov else None,
    'ordering_customers_baseline': b_customers,
    'ordering_customers_comparison': c_customers,
    'repeat_customers_baseline': b_repeat,
    'repeat_customers_comparison': c_repeat,
    'repeat_rate_baseline': b_repeat_rate,
    'repeat_rate_comparison': c_repeat_rate,
    'repeat_rate_change_pp': repeat_rate_change_pp,
    'repeat_rate_relative_change_pct': (repeat_rate_relative * 100) if repeat_rate_relative is not None else None,
    'region_revenue_sum_baseline_source_units': region_revenue_b,
    'region_revenue_sum_comparison_source_units': region_revenue_c,
    'region_revenue_vs_header_diff_baseline_source_units': region_revenue_b - b_revenue,
    'region_revenue_vs_header_diff_comparison_source_units': region_revenue_c - c_revenue,
    'region_order_sum_baseline': region_orders_b,
    'region_order_sum_comparison': region_orders_c,
    'unknown_region_group_count': int(len(unknown_regions)),
    'unknown_region_revenue_baseline_source_units': float(unknown_regions['revenue_2002_source_units'].sum()),
    'unknown_region_revenue_comparison_source_units': float(unknown_regions['revenue_2003_source_units'].sum()),
    'category_revenue_sum_baseline_source_units': category_revenue_b,
    'category_revenue_sum_comparison_source_units': category_revenue_c,
    'category_vs_detail_diff_baseline_source_units': category_revenue_b - float(quality.loc[b_year, 'total_line_revenue_source_units']),
    'category_vs_detail_diff_comparison_source_units': category_revenue_c - float(quality.loc[c_year, 'total_line_revenue_source_units']),
    'unclassified_line_count_baseline': int(quality.loc[b_year, 'unclassified_line_count']),
    'unclassified_line_count_comparison': int(quality.loc[c_year, 'unclassified_line_count']),
    'unclassified_revenue_baseline_source_units': float(quality.loc[b_year, 'unclassified_revenue_source_units']),
    'unclassified_revenue_comparison_source_units': float(quality.loc[c_year, 'unclassified_revenue_source_units']),
    'dimension_join_duplicate_line_keys_baseline': int(quality.loc[b_year, 'duplicate_line_key_count_after_dimension_joins']),
    'dimension_join_duplicate_line_keys_comparison': int(quality.loc[c_year, 'duplicate_line_key_count_after_dimension_joins']),
    'header_detail_revenue_diff_baseline_source_units': float(recon.loc[b_year, 'header_minus_detail_linetotal']),
    'header_detail_revenue_diff_comparison_source_units': float(recon.loc[c_year, 'header_minus_detail_linetotal']),
    'orders_without_detail_baseline': int(recon.loc[b_year, 'orders_without_detail']),
    'orders_without_detail_comparison': int(recon.loc[c_year, 'orders_without_detail']),
    'header_line_join_row_growth_baseline': int(recon.loc[b_year, 'join_row_growth']),
    'header_line_join_row_growth_comparison': int(recon.loc[c_year, 'join_row_growth'])
}])
